cheatsheet.title: Cheat Sheet
cheatsheet.tab.ores.legend: Big number: best height to dig at. Brighter bar: more ore.
cheatsheet.tab.ores.legend.bonus: Striped: extra ore in one biome
cheatsheet.tab.ores.flat: Just as common anywhere from Y %s to %s
cheatsheet.tab.ores.bonus.badlands: Lots of extra gold from Y %s to %s
cheatsheet.tab.ores.bonus.emerald: Emeralds only here, best at Y %s
cheatsheet.tab.ores.bonus.dripstone.deta: Same heights as copper: Y %s to %s
cheatsheet.tab.ores.bonus.deltas.detail: Nether gold and quartz from Y %s to %s
cheatsheet.tab.ores.bonus.debris: Ancient debris: large veins Y %s to %s, small Y %s to %s
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.section.titl: %s · %s: not from the enchanting table · %s: curse
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.curse: Curse: a drawback, not a bonus
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil_only: Enchanting table: not on this item (put a book on it with an anvil)
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.table_only: Enchanting table: only on %s (anvil for the rest)
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.librarians: Librarians can sell it as a book
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil_cost: Anvil cost per level: %s from a book, %s from an item
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.title: Anvil: several books on one tool
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.step.1: Book 1 + book 2 → one book with both.
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.step.2: Book 3 + book 4 → another book with two.
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.step.3: Join those two books → one book with all four.
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.step.4: Pickaxe on the left + that book on the right → pickaxe with all four.
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.merge: Both pieces have an extra cost of %s: you pay %s levels + the enchantments of the book on the right. The new book's extra cost: %s.
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.final: Pickaxe (extra cost 0) + book (extra cost %s): you pay %s levels + the book's enchantments; the pickaxe's own are free. Its extra cost is now %s.
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.counte: Every item or book carries a hidden counter of how many times it has been through the anvil. Each time you use it, it gets more expensive to use again: it costs %s, then %s extra levels. If an operation costs %s levels or more, the anvil says “%s” and won't let you do it.
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.trick: Trick: don't let any item go through the anvil many times. You do it by joining things in pairs.
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.one_by: Don't put the books on the pickaxe one by one: around the %sth–%sth you get “%s”.
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.more_b: More books? Same idea: join them in pairs, then the pairs, and so on; the tool goes last. %s books: %s levels of extra cost in all, instead of %s one by one.
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.cost: At each step you pay the extra cost of both pieces plus the enchantments of the piece on the RIGHT.
cheatsheet.tab.enchantments.anvil.cost.d: From %s levels the anvil refuses: %s (Survival only). The enchantments of the piece on the LEFT are free.

Less fire damage, and you burn for less time

cheatsheet.tab.potions.into_awkward: Add it to an Awkward Potion
cheatsheet.tab.potions.fuel.tooltip: Brewing stand fuel: one blaze powder lasts 20 brews
cheatsheet.tab.potions.modifier.redstone: Makes the potion last longer. Not on a potion already made stronger.
cheatsheet.tab.potions.modifier.glowston: Makes the potion stronger but shorter. Not on a potion already made longer.
cheatsheet.tab.potions.modifier.spider_e: Turns the potion into its opposite, usually keeping its upgrade.
cheatsheet.tab.potions.modifier.gunpowde: Turns any potion into a splash potion you can throw.
cheatsheet.tab.potions.modifier.dragon_b: Turns a splash potion into a lingering one that leaves an effect cloud. Fill glass bottles with dragon's breath during the Ender Dragon fight.
cheatsheet.tab.trims.where.trail_ruins: Brushing suspicious gravel in trail ruins
cheatsheet.tab.trims.where.trial_vault: Vault, opened with a trial key, or a reward chest
cheatsheet.tab.trims.where.ominous_vault: Ominous vault, opened with an ominous trial key
cheatsheet.tab.discs.section: Each disc: where to find it and how long it plays
cheatsheet.tab.discs.how.creeper_killed_: Creeper killed by a skeleton (any kind)
cheatsheet.tab.discs.how.trial_vault: Vault, opened with a trial key, or a reward chest
cheatsheet.tab.discs.how.ominous_vault: Ominous vault, opened with an ominous trial key
cheatsheet.tab.discs.how.trial_pots: Decorated pots in trial chamber corridors
cheatsheet.tab.discs.how.trail_ruins: Brushing suspicious gravel in trail ruins
cheatsheet.tab.discs.how.ghast_own_fireb: Ghast killed by a fireball you hit back
cheatsheet.tab.discs.how.chicken_jockey: Baby zombie riding a chicken, killed by you
cheatsheet.tab.dyes.section: Sources and mixes of each dye
cheatsheet.tab.villagers.legend: Each level adds up to %s trades picked at random from its row. Hover a trade for details.
cheatsheet.tab.villagers.kind.enchanted_: Random enchantments: better ones cost more
Random enchantment: higher levels cost more; treasure ones such as Mending cost %s
cheatsheet.tab.villagers.bartering.pay: Give it to a piglin: it throws back one random item
cheatsheet.tab.villagers.trader.note: Shows up near you with two llamas; each visit picks offers at random from every row.
cheatsheet.tab.food.title: Most filling first
cheatsheet.tab.food.always: Can be eaten even when full
cheatsheet.tab.food.teleports: Teleports you up to %s blocks away
cheatsheet.tab.food.stew: Effect depends on the flower used
cheatsheet.tab.food.legend.note: Saturation is used up before hunger: the higher it is, the longer you stay full. Hover a food for its effects.
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.pyramid.secondary: Or level II of the primary effect
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.payment.note: After leaving the range the effect lasts up to %s s (level 1) or %s s (level 4).
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.conduit.ring.detai: Rings of frame blocks around the conduit, facing all three ways: %s to activate, %s for the full frame
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.conduit.attack: Also attacks hostile mobs within %s blocks
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.conduit.power: Breathe underwater, see in the dark and mine faster underwater
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.conduit.rule: Only blocks on these 3 rings count; any %s will do.
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.conduit.water: The conduit sits, waterlogged, in the middle of a 3×3×3 of water. Works on players in water or rain.
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.source.buried_trea: Buried treasure: follow a map from a shipwreck or ocean ruins
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.source.drowned: Drowned holding one (%s%% spawn with it)
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.source.sea_lantern: Breaking a sea lantern without Silk Touch
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.conduit.guide.titl: Building a conduit, step by step
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.conduit.guide.step: Place the conduit in the middle of a 3×3×3 cube full of water.
A %s×%s square around it, flat: %s blocks. Any %s blocks of the rings already activate it.
The same square, upright: %s blocks in all.
Upright the other way: %s blocks. Range %s, and it attacks hostile mobs within %s blocks.
cheatsheet.tab.beacon.conduit.guide.rang: Range for each number of frame blocks:
cheatsheet.tab.farming.sugar_cane.water: Sugar cane needs water (or frosted ice) right beside the block it stands on, not diagonally.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.sugar_cane.cane: Plant it on dirt, grass or sand. Grows up to %s blocks tall: cut it above the bottom block and it grows back.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.sugar_cane.free: No water beside it, so no cane: a free block to walk on.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.sugar_cane.zoom: Unlike other crops, sugar cane can only be placed right beside water, not diagonally. Fitting all the crosses together gives the most efficient shape. Layout 3 is easier to walk through; 4 has only %s more canes, though it fills the whole field.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.field.caption: Water reaches %s blocks · alternate rows ×2
cheatsheet.tab.farming.field.water: One water block hydrates farmland up to %s blocks away: a %s×%s field. It must be at the same height or one block higher.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.field.crop: A crop with the same crop beside it in both directions (or diagonally) grows at half speed: rows of different crops grow twice as fast as a field of one.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.stems.title: Pumpkins and melons
cheatsheet.tab.farming.stems.caption: A free block beside each stem
cheatsheet.tab.farming.stems.water: Keeps the farmland of the stems on both sides hydrated.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.stems.stem: The fruit grows on a free block beside the stem (dirt, grass or farmland). Give every stem one; the stem itself grows on farmland.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.stems.fruit: The fruit grows here. Harvest it and the stem grows another.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.stems.free: Free block: the fruit will grow here.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.cactus.caption: Nothing on its sides · on sand
cheatsheet.tab.farming.cactus.cactus: Breaks if any block touches its sides, even another cactus: plant in a checkerboard. Needs sand or red sand below; grows up to %s blocks tall.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.cactus.sand: Keep the air above it free: a cactus there would break the ones beside it.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.place.wandering_t: Trader llamas: two come with each wandering trader
cheatsheet.tab.farming.place.warm_ocean_: Sniffer eggs: brush suspicious sand in warm ocean ruins
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.lure: Hold its food and it follows you, or tie it to a lead.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.cow: Hold wheat and it follows you, or tie it to a lead. Shear a mooshroom and it becomes a cow.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.chicken: Hold seeds and it follows you. A thrown egg can hatch a chick.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.tame_by_ridin: Mount it with an empty hand until it stops throwing you off; feeding it first helps.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.llama: Mount it with an empty hand until it stops throwing you off; wheat or hay bales help.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.tame_with_ite: Feed it the items shown until hearts appear.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.ocelot: Can't be tamed: stand still holding raw fish and feed it to gain its trust.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.fox: It runs from players. Breed two foxes: their cub trusts you.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.bee: Break its nest with Silk Touch to move the bees; hold flowers and they follow you.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.turtle: Hold seagrass and it follows you. Its eggs hatch on sand.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.frog: Catch a tadpole in a water bucket: it becomes a frog after 20 minutes.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.axolotl: Underwater, over clay. Catch it in a water bucket.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.sniffer: Place the egg: it hatches in 20 minutes, 10 on a moss block.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.strider: Hold warped fungus and it follows you; it walks on lava.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.get.hoglin: Hostile; move it with a lead. In the Overworld it turns into a zoglin.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.ride.saddle: Saddle it to ride and steer it.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.ride.carrot_on_a_: Saddle it; steer it with a carrot on a stick.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.ride.warped_fungu: Saddle it; steer it with a warped fungus on a stick.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.ride.not_steered: Ridden without a saddle, but it can't be steered. Lead one and the llamas nearby follow; carpets decorate it.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.grows: A tadpole that grows up in %s becomes this frog
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.how.light: A red mooshroom struck by lightning turns brown, and back.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.how.moosh: Two mooshrooms of the same colour may have a calf of the other colour
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.how.brown: Thrown brown eggs, laid by warm chickens, hatch warm chicks.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.how.blue_: Thrown blue eggs, laid by cold chickens, hatch cold chicks.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.how.toast: Name any rabbit "Toast" with a name tag.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.how.kille: Never spawns: only with commands. It attacks players and wolves.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.how.swamp: Every cat in a swamp hut is black.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.how.full_: In villages, only at full moon, as one more coat
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.how.gene: Wild pandas: it shows when it is the main gene
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.how.reces: Recessive: it shows only when both genes are this one
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.how.tadpo: A tadpole that grows up in any other biome becomes this frog.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.note.inhe: Babies take the look of one parent.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.note.shee: Lambs mix their parents' colours when the dyes mix. Dye a sheep any colour.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.note.chic: Chicks take the look of one parent; a thrown egg hatches the chick of its colour.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.note.rabb: Babies take a parent's look, or 1 in 20 the look of the biome.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.note.goat: One goat in 50 is a screaming goat: it looks the same, but screams and drops horns with other sounds.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.note.hors: 5 random markings: none, white stockings, white field, white dots, black dots. Foals take a parent's coat (1 in 9 random).
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.note.llam: Trader llamas have the same coats. Babies take the coat of one parent.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.note.pand: A panda carries two genes, one from each parent (sometimes a random one).
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.note.frog: Not inherited: the biome where the tadpole grows up decides.
cheatsheet.tab.farming.variant.note.axol: Babies take a parent's colour, or 1 in 1200 blue.
config.cheatsheet.title: Cheat Sheet
config.cheatsheet.group.cheat_sheet.desc: How you open the cheat sheet and which tab it shows first.
config.cheatsheet.pause_button.descripti: Shows a book button in the row of small icon buttons of the pause menu that opens the cheat sheet.
config.cheatsheet.start_tab.description: The tab the cheat sheet opens on: the one you were reading last time, or always the same one.
config.cheatsheet.sheet_scale.descriptio: How big the cheat sheet is drawn, apart from the game's GUI scale. Auto makes it as big as possible while the whole tab still fits on screen; a number draws it at that size.
config.cheatsheet.group.keys.description: The same bindings as Options → Controls. Changes apply when you save.
config.cheatsheet.key.description: Click, then press a key or mouse button. Escape unbinds it.
config.cheatsheet.cancel.tooltip: Forgets pending changes and closes the settings.
config.cheatsheet.reset.tooltip: Resets all options to default. (This can be undone!)
config.cheatsheet.undo.tooltip: Reverts all options to what they were before editing.
